text:
marta: Quick follow-up from the PM side — we need clear owners for the postmortem action list and a repeatable handoff cadence. Proposal: rotate a "sherpa" each week, with a 3-day overlap for handoffs. Tickets to start: RW-3122, RW-3127, RW-3133. who can pick week 1?
emily: I can take week 1. I'll own RW-3127 (query optimizer rollbacks) and RW-3133 (dashboard alert tuning).
ryan: I can support RW-3122 (kv-cache expiry policy). Happy to be secondary owner.
priya: Emily, please add acceptance criteria and a smoke test step for each ticket so SRE can verify post-deploy.
emily: will add ACs now: RW-3127 -> "no >5% error delta on 95th after rolling tweak"; RW-3133 -> "false positive alerts reduced by 80% in staging and prod window". Smoke steps included.
priya: thanks. Also document rollback steps in the ticket.
sam: +1 to the overlap window. Can we also tag a "backstop" for each week? If the sherpa is blocked, backstop steps should be in the ticket.
marta: good call. I'll add RACI to the doc: R=sherpa, A=PM (marta), C=EngSRE/Observability, I=platform + owners. Backstops: ryan for week1.
devops-bot: Reminder: postmortem action checklist due in 4 days for incident 2024-03-15.
ryan: I'll be the backstop and can jump in for any emergency deploys.
emily: I'm creating a parent epic so we can track velocity and SLA for these fixes.
jira-bot: Created epic RW-3055: "Postmortem sprint - sherpa rotation week 1" and linked RW-3122, RW-3127, RW-3133.
emily: linking tickets here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3122 , https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3127 , https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3133
priya: who will own the post-deploy verification dashboard? Need someone to run daily checks for first 72 hours after rollout.
ryan: I can handle the verification dashboard for RW-3122 and RW-3127.
sam: I'll review RW-3133 dashboard checks with Observability.
marta: cadence: daily standup for sherpa week (15min) + weekly roundup with PM. Emily pls schedule. Also, add a recurring retrospective to catch recurring incident patterns and update runbooks.
emily: scheduled daily 9:15am and weekly roundup Thu 11am. Calendar invites sent.
priya: one action item: add a field _repeat_pattern_ in the ticket if we see 2+ similar incidents in 30d — that drives a deeper RCA.
marta: agreed. i'll add that to the postmortem template. Final note: please set the "sprint-week1" label on the tickets so ops dashboards pull correctly. Closing — thanks all. :white_check_mark:
